facts.activity_file: identifying every energy source for a task

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
controlled removal of isolation and return to service

parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on P-9501 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-9501 and PT-9501 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-9501 and PT-9501 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-9501 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during routine operation while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 December 2017 an incident occurred on P-9501 and PT-9501 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
